dedupe_keys.name: crealab open database on energy storage technologies and grid services

description: This database collects technical, economic and performance information on short- and long-duration energy storage technologies and the energy and grid services they provide. It was published on Zenodo in August 2026 (version 1.0) by Andrea Lanzini, Francesco Demetrio Minuto, Marcel Stolte and Tobias Rieper as deliverable D1.3.2 of the Italian Circular Renewable Energy Area Living Lab (CREALab) project. It gives, per technology, energy-to-power ratio, round-trip efficiency, response time, depth of discharge, cycle life, capital cost, energy and power density and technology readiness level; a list of national and international storage projects installed or in development, with technology, location, stated power and capacity, date or status, parties, services and source; a mapping between technologies, discharge duration and applications; and references. Technology families include lithium-ion, sodium-ion, redox flow batteries, long-duration storage, power-to-hydrogen-to-power and gravity storage. Coverage is not limited to one country. The data are one Excel workbook in Italian, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the workbook is small and values come from the literature. Simulation uses are storage parameters for capacity expansion and flexibility models. Related records: data-rnm-us-equipment-catalog is another equipment parameter catalogue for grid studies.
